title: exposure row
description: One line of data/exposure/<dataset_id>.jsonl (RFC-031 H1, RFC-032 step 6): a read of one held-out item, by a person or an agent. Appended, never rewritten; once read, always read. The register belongs to a sealed side.

what.description: What was read (a comparison, a sheet, a public repo naming it).

by.description: The reader: person:NAME or agent:NAME (with ` for person:NAME`).

source.description: `hand`: evh exposure-add; `harness`: a command that showed the item.
